title: World Generation Probability Cloud
text: One of each of the nine microcores opens another framework evolution: early workshops, Dream strata and Spacetime strata. Right-click the completed Dream gateway to cross; the Spacetime breach crosses automatically. View each offering in the framework hints or JEI.

An Encapsulated Stable Spacetime Aggregate, Active World Seed, Spacetime Spell Core and four Genesis Particles collapse the final world into a probability cloud. Remaining materials are consumed. Taking the cloud resets the framework.

Use the cloud as an Alchemical Catalysis Chamber substrate, with a Time, Space or Omni Microcore seed and Dilute Spacetime. Each cycle yields four matching microcores, retaining substrate and seed. No natural growth occurs without liquid.
